description: Subsurface Testing for Evaluating Seasonal Changes in Groundwater Table and Liquefaction Hazard in Napier, New Zealand is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Andrew Stolte, University of Auckland (aucklanduni.ac.nz). This project contains geotechnical and geophysical field data collected to evaluate seasonal changes in groundwater table and liquefaction hazard in Napier, New Zealand. The study focuses on three sites located near historical observations of liquefaction manifestation following the ~Mw 7.7 1931 Hawke’s Bay earthquake (detailed by El Kortbawi 2017). Coverage: Napier, New Zealand. DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Earthquake, Soil Liquefaction, SCPT, MASW, MAM, HVSR. Published 2025-10-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
